title: Seal wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 36,38 64,38' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 43,23 57,23' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 46,16 54,16' fill='#4fd2ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='4' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <!-- seal body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='34' ry='22' fill='#5a7fb0'/>
  <!-- seal belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='22' ry='14' fill='#a7c4e6'/>
  <!-- seal head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#6d92c4'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#a7c4e6'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='42' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#1b2a44'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='42' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#1b2a44'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='40' r='1.6' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='40' r='1.6' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='49' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#2e3f5c'/>
  <!-- whisker dots -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='53' r='1' fill='#4a6a94'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='55' r='1' fill='#4a6a94'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='55' r='1' fill='#4a6a94'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='53' r='1' fill='#4a6a94'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 58 Q50 61 54 58' stroke='#4a6a94' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='30' y1='50' x2='38' y2='51' stroke='#a7c4e6' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='55' x2='38' y2='54' stroke='#a7c4e6' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='50' x2='62' y2='51' stroke='#a7c4e6' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='55' x2='62' y2='54' stroke='#a7c4e6' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- flippers -->
  <ellipse cx='17' cy='76' rx='8' ry='12' fill='#4a6a94' transform='rotate(-20 17 76)'/>
  <ellipse cx='83' cy='76' rx='8' ry='12' fill='#4a6a94' transform='rotate(20 83 76)'/>
</svg>
